question: Calculate: \(180 - 90 = ?\)
solution: A straight angle is 180 degrees. A straight angle contains 2 right angles. Each right angle measures 90 degrees, so taking away one right angle leaves the other: \(180 - 90 = 90\).

edges.reason: Column subtraction provides regrouping experience. Decomposition, counting-on or subtraction of unit counts can compute the oral result without that written algorithm.
